_readme: Corrections to the survey data, confirmed by the REACH team.
satisfaction (28 Sep 2026): six respondents picked the wrong end of the scale. Each rated
quality, timeliness and recommendation highly and wrote positive or neutral comments, but
answered 'Very dissatisfied'. Keyed by TA Case Number. 'from' is the value in the source
workbook and must match, so a later export that changes the row is flagged rather than
silently overwritten; a row that already reads 'to' is left alone.
exclude (28 Sep 2026): responses removed from the Feedback data entirely, keyed by survey
response ID. 'office' must match the workbook, as a check that the ID still means the same row.
